description: Extra catalog facts about one Amazon ASIN that amzscout_analyze_product does not include: bullet features, materials, included components, ingredients, hazmat info, UPCs and manufacturer; on request also frequently-bought-together / bundle ASINs, listing videos, return rate, brand store link and buy box seller history. No sales, price or review numbers — those come from amzscout_analyze_product. Pure data fetch (no AI analysis). When to call: together with amzscout_analyze_product whenever the user asks about one specific product (same ASIN and marketplace), so the answer carries the listing facts as well as the numbers. Call WITHOUT `sections` by default (returns catalog + identifiers); add relations / media / buybox only when the question is about them. How to use: describe what the product actually is and how it is positioned — key features, materials, what is in the box, compliance flags (hazmat, ingredients) — and point out what a competing listing would need to match or beat. Present facts as written on the listing; do not invent missing ones. Marketplace: if the user has not named a country / Amazon domain in this conversation, ask them once which marketplace they work on and reuse that code for every later call in the chat; do not assume the US. Called without `marketplace`, this tool fetches nothing and answers "MARKETPLACE NEEDED". Money is in that marketplace's local currency.

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace code — the one the user named, or the one they chose earlier in this conversation (ask once, then reuse it for every call). Never assume the US for an ASIN: without it, ASIN tools fetch nothing and answer "MARKETPLACE NEEDED". Money in results is in this marketplace's currency.

sections.description: Which data to return. Omit for the default (catalog + identifiers). Request others only when the question needs them — relations, media and buybox are slower. Options: "catalog" (bullet features, materials, included components, active / special ingredients, item highlights, hazmat info); "identifiers" (UPC codes and manufacturer); "relations" (frequently-bought-together and bundle ASINs); "media" (listing videos (title, length, creator, link)); "buybox" (return rate (low / high), brand store link, buy box seller-ID history).
